entities.name: PMID:25077574
observations: In 11 healthy adults, 4-minute bilateral BL23 indirect moxibustion reduced renal segmental-artery RI from 0.578±0.037 at baseline to 0.546±0.027 immediately and 0.547±0.032 at 10 minutes; p=0.003 and p=0.005 versus baseline.

entities.name: PMID:26983055
observations: In 43 people with CKD, indirect moxibustion at bilateral BL23 reduced median renal segmental-artery RI from 0.590 at baseline to 0.565 immediately and 0.561 at 10 minutes, both p<0.001; the 10-minute reduction exceeded control by 0.023 RI units, p=0.001.

entities.name: Indirect moxibustion lowers renal RI
observations: Direct studies consistently report short-term decreases in Doppler-measured renal segmental/interlobar arterial resistive index after indirect moxibustion at BL23.
Evidence is limited to immediate post-treatment effects from small studies; it does not establish long-term kidney outcomes.
